title.narrative: BBC Media Action: Klahan9, 2019-2020 - BBCMA: Klahan9, 2019-2020

description.narrative: BBC Media Action har inkommit till den svenska ambassaden i Phnom Penh med en begäran om finansiering av en tredje fas av multi-mediainsatsen "Klahan9" i Kambodja under perioden 1 januari 2019 till 30 juni 2020. Insatsen avser att förbättra unga kambodjaners förståelse för arbetsmarknadsfrågor i allmänhet och hur de kan uppnå karriärs- och yrkesrelaterade mål, vilket uppnås genom en kombinerad användning av olika medieplattformar. Den totala budgeten för insatsen uppgår till SEK 14 000 000.

BBC Media Action has approached the Swedish Embassy in Phnom Penh for funding of SEK 14 million to carry out a third phase of the multi-media intervention "Klahan9" in Cambodia during the period 2019 to 2020. The intervention aims to improve young Cambodians understanding of labour market issues in general and how they can attain their career and employment goals in specific, which is achievedthrough a combined use of different media platforms. The total budget for the intervention amounts to SEK 14 000 000.

The overall objective of Klahan9 is to support young people to take practical steps towards establishing and attaining their career and employment goals which will in turn lead to young people understanding the livelihoods opportunities available to them, navigating the challenges involved in pursuing them and taking action to fulfil their economic potential.
